root_target: minimal finite constraint-survival process unique only up to the complete admissible probe family
nominalist_rule: the attractor is the invariant overlap among admissible views and translations, not a hidden carrier asserted behind them

source_packets.role: advisory basin-engineering vision and application proposal only

rows.probe_family: finite POVM, channel, cut, spectrum, and distinguishability probes
rows.quotient_objects: density-state and channel equivalence classes under the declared probes
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: surviving finite distinctions under admissible ordered maps
rows.projection: not yet defined from one independently executable core
rows.lift: QIT failures constrain candidate core maps
rows.ablation: erase noncommutation or dissipation and require the paired core/domain signature to change

rows.probe_family: SLD/QFI, BKM, relative entropy, and transport-action probes
rows.quotient_objects: state distinctions and admissible paths modulo metric resolution
rows.domain_dynamics: detailed-balance quantum Markov semigroup as a candidate entropy gradient flow
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: entropy decrease paired with terrain-derived transport geometry
rows.lift: curvature or transport failures would reject a terrain geometry
rows.ablation: break detailed balance while matching stationary state and test loss of gradient-flow identity

rows.probe_family: trajectory count, activity, tilted-generator spectrum, and no-message probes
rows.quotient_objects: history classes under a declared time-integrated observable
rows.domain_dynamics: tilted Lindbladian and quantum Doob transformed process
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: survivor weighting without backward controllable signalling
rows.lift: Doob positivity, trace preservation, or signalling failures constrain the history model
rows.ablation: one-history collapse and erased tilt must destroy conditioned-history separation

rows.probe_family: boundary persistence, flux, viability, prediction error, and intervention probes
rows.quotient_objects: viable organizations under finite boundary and environmental probes
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: bounded persistence under variation and exposure
rows.lift: viability failures would constrain candidate core admissibility
rows.ablation: destroy the boundary or energy flux while preserving superficial state labels

rows.probe_family: self-model, alternative-action, salience, report, and perturbation probes
rows.quotient_objects: recursive models distinguished by finite behavioral and internal readouts
rows.domain_dynamics: candidate recursive boundary and action-model update
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: retained counterfactual distinctions under self-model revision
rows.ablation: remove recursive self-model access while matching task performance

rows.probe_family: finite traces, transition observations, bisimulation, and mutation probes
rows.quotient_objects: behavioral equivalence classes of transition systems
rows.domain_dynamics: finite state transition or coalgebraic evolution
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: identity by future observable behavior rather than internal essence
rows.projection: candidate mapping from finite probe fingerprints to behavioral quotients
rows.lift: bisimulation counterexamples refine the probe family
rows.ablation: merge non-bisimilar states or erase a distinguishing trace

rows.probe_family: finite compatible measurement contexts and gluing probes
rows.quotient_objects: locally consistent sections under a measurement cover
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: local consistency without a privileged global assignment
rows.lift: global-section obstruction constrains proposed all-view collapses
rows.ablation: replace the contextual cover with a globally satisfiable control

rows.probe_family: proposal, execution, evidence, rejection, replay, quorum, and mutation probes
rows.quotient_objects: contextual claims and admitted graph objects, never the private carrier
rows.domain_dynamics: capture, refine, judge, execute, receipt, and graph update
rows.projection: candidate mapping from Ratchet proof bundles to Lev claims and gates
rows.lift: runtime failures return evidence but never mutate Ratchet truth
rows.ablation: remove receipts, local verification, or idempotency and measure convergence failure

rows.probe_family: finite cut, channel, detector, covariance, galaxy, lensing, and cosmology probes
rows.quotient_objects: empirically indistinguishable physical models under frozen datasets
rows.domain_dynamics: not derived from the finite carrier
rows.shared_invariant_candidate: oriented cut response and history-conditioned correlation geometry
rows.lift: external data reject proposed bridges and feed constraints back to the core
rows.ablation: sign reversal, conservation, coefficient, out-of-sample, and lensing controls

claim_ceiling: typed cross-view research queue only; no shared attractor, semiconjugacy, cross-domain prediction, physics, life, consciousness, or mesh unification is admitted
